cards.title: Making plans with a friend
cards.examiner_intro: We are now going to complete Task 1 of the test, which is the role play. You are talking to your friend. You want to go to the cinema together to see a film. I am your friend. I will speak first.
cards.candidate_situation: You are talking to your friend. You want to go to the cinema together to see a film. The examiner will play the role of your friend and will speak first.

examiner_prompts.spoken: How often do you go to the cinema?
What type of film do you want to see?
When do you want to go to the cinema?
We should have something to eat before the film. What do you want to eat?
Do you have a question for me?
examiner_prompts.brief_reply: The tickets are eight pounds each.

cards.title: Booking transport
cards.examiner_intro: We are now going to complete Task 1 of the test, which is the role play. You are at a train station. You want to buy tickets for a train. I am the ticket assistant. I will speak first.
cards.candidate_situation: You are at a train station. You want to buy tickets for a train. The examiner will play the role of the ticket assistant.

examiner_prompts.spoken: Hello. Where do you want to travel to today?
How many tickets do you need?
What are you going to do there?
What day do you want to return?
Do you have a question for me?
examiner_prompts.brief_reply: The train leaves at half past nine.

cards.title: After-school activities
cards.examiner_intro: We are now going to complete Task 1 of the test, which is the role play. You are talking to a friend about after-school clubs. I am your friend. I will speak first.
cards.candidate_situation: You are talking to a friend about after-school activities that you take part in. The examiner will play the role of your friend and will speak first.

examiner_prompts.spoken: What is your favourite after-school club?
How often do you go to the after-school club?
Who do you go to the after-school club with?
What do you enjoy about the after-school club?
Do you have a question for me?
examiner_prompts.brief_reply: Yes, I would like to come next week.

cards.title: Job application
cards.examiner_intro: We are now going to complete Task 1 of the test, which is the role play. You want a job in a supermarket. You are speaking to the manager. I will play the role of the manager. I will speak first.
cards.candidate_situation: You want a job in a supermarket. You are speaking to the manager.

examiner_prompts.spoken: Why do you want a job at this supermarket?
What days of the week can you work?
How many hours can you work each week?
How will you travel to work?
Do you have a question for me?
examiner_prompts.brief_reply: You could start on Monday morning.

cards.title: Doctor appointment
cards.examiner_intro: We are now going to complete Task 1 of the test, which is the role play. You are at a doctor's reception. You want to make an appointment. I am the receptionist. I will speak first.
cards.candidate_situation: You are at a doctor's reception. You want to make an appointment. The examiner is the receptionist.

examiner_prompts.spoken: Good morning. How can I help you?
Which day would be better for you?
Have you been to this clinic before?
Would you prefer morning or afternoon?
Do you have a question for me?
examiner_prompts.brief_reply: The appointment usually lasts about fifteen minutes.

cards.title: Hotel booking
cards.examiner_intro: We are now going to complete Task 1 of the test, which is the role play. You are booking a hotel room. I am the hotel receptionist. I will speak first.
cards.candidate_situation: You are booking a hotel room for a short trip. The examiner is the receptionist.

examiner_prompts.spoken: Hello. How many nights would you like to stay?
What type of room would you like?
Is the booking for one person or more?
Would you like breakfast included?
Do you have a question for me?
examiner_prompts.brief_reply: There is a swimming pool and free wifi.

cards.title: School project meeting
cards.examiner_intro: We are now going to complete Task 1 of the test, which is the role play. You are talking to a classmate about a school project. I am your classmate. I will speak first.
cards.candidate_situation: You are arranging a meeting with a classmate to work on a school project.

examiner_prompts.spoken: What is our project about?
When can we meet this week?
How long do you think we will need?
Where should we meet?
Do you have a question for me?
examiner_prompts.brief_reply: I can bring coloured paper and a laptop.

cards.title: Work experience enquiry
cards.examiner_intro: We are now going to complete Task 1 of the test, which is the role play. You are asking about work experience at a local company. I am the office manager. I will speak first.
cards.candidate_situation: You are asking about a week of work experience at a local company. The examiner is the office manager.

examiner_prompts.spoken: Why are you interested in work experience with us?
Which week are you free?
Have you done any work like this before?
What skills can you bring to the office?
Do you have a question for me?
examiner_prompts.brief_reply: Please wear smart clothes, but you do not need a suit.

cards.title: Sports club membership
cards.examiner_intro: We are now going to complete Task 1 of the test, which is the role play. You want to join a local sports club. I am a member of the club. I will speak first.
cards.candidate_situation: You want to join a local sports club. The examiner is a member of the club and will speak first.

examiner_prompts.spoken: Which sport would you like to do at the club?
How often would you like to train?
Have you played this sport before?
Who would you like to come with?
Do you have a question for me?
examiner_prompts.brief_reply: It costs fifteen pounds a month.

cards.title: Recycling at school
cards.examiner_intro: We are now going to complete Task 1 of the test, which is the role play. You are talking to a classmate about a recycling project at school. I am your classmate. I will speak first.
cards.candidate_situation: You are talking to a classmate about a recycling project at school. The examiner is your classmate.

examiner_prompts.spoken: What do you want our class to recycle?
Why is this project important?
When should we start?
How can students help?
Do you have a question for me?
examiner_prompts.brief_reply: The bins are next to the school hall.

cards.title: Restaurant booking
cards.examiner_intro: We are now going to complete Task 1 of the test, which is the role play. You are booking a table at a restaurant. I am the waiter. I will speak first.
cards.candidate_situation: You are booking a table at a restaurant for a family meal. The examiner is the waiter.

examiner_prompts.spoken: Hello. How many people is the booking for?
Which day would you like to come?
What time would you like the table?
Is there a type of food you prefer?
Do you have a question for me?
examiner_prompts.brief_reply: Yes, we have several vegetarian dishes.

cards.title: School newspaper interview
cards.examiner_intro: We are now going to complete Task 1 of the test, which is the role play. You are being interviewed for the school newspaper about your hobby. I am the student journalist. I will speak first.
cards.candidate_situation: A student journalist is interviewing you about your hobby for the school newspaper. The examiner is the journalist.

examiner_prompts.spoken: What is your hobby?
How long have you done this hobby?
Who do you do it with?
Why do you enjoy it?
Do you have a question for me?
examiner_prompts.brief_reply: The newspaper comes out next Friday.

cards.title: Charity volunteer
cards.examiner_intro: We are now going to complete Task 1 of the test, which is the role play. You want to volunteer at a charity shop. I am the shop manager. I will speak first.
cards.candidate_situation: You want to volunteer at a local charity shop. The examiner is the shop manager.

examiner_prompts.spoken: Why do you want to volunteer here?
Which days can you help?
How many hours can you give each week?
What kind of jobs can you do in the shop?
Do you have a question for me?
examiner_prompts.brief_reply: We are open from ten until four.

cards.title: Family celebration
cards.examiner_intro: We are now going to complete Task 1 of the test, which is the role play. You are planning a family celebration with a relative. I am your cousin. I will speak first.
cards.candidate_situation: You are planning a family celebration with your cousin. The examiner is your cousin.

examiner_prompts.spoken: What celebration are we planning?
Where should we have it?
How many people should we invite?
What food should we bring?
Do you have a question for me?

cards.title: Technology shop help
cards.examiner_intro: We are now going to complete Task 1 of the test, which is the role play. You are in a technology shop. You want to buy a laptop. I am the shop assistant. I will speak first.
cards.candidate_situation: You are in a technology shop and you want to buy a laptop. The examiner is the shop assistant.

examiner_prompts.spoken: Hello. Why do you need a laptop?
What is your budget?
Will you use it for school or for games?
Which features are most important for you?
Do you have a question for me?
examiner_prompts.brief_reply: Yes, there is a two-year guarantee.

cards.title: Library study space
cards.examiner_intro: We are now going to complete Task 1 of the test, which is the role play. You are at the library. You want to book a study room. I am the librarian. I will speak first.
cards.candidate_situation: You are at the library and you want to book a study room. The examiner is the librarian.

examiner_prompts.spoken: Why do you need a study room?
Which day would you like?
How long will you need it?
How many people will use the room?
Do you have a question for me?
examiner_prompts.brief_reply: Yes, the wifi is free for students.
